full_name: Mary Franklin-Brown | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow University of Minnesota
bio: Mary Franklin-Brown is an associate professor of French and a member of the graduate faculty of the Center for Medieval Studies at the University of Minnesota. She specializes in literature and intellectual history of the 12th and 13th centuries in a comparative perspective, working on sources in Catalan, Latin, Old French, and Old Occitan.
